ClawGuard Threat Detector v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Introduces real-time behavioral monitoring and attack pattern detection for OpenClaw environments.
- Maps threats to MITRE ATT&CK framework and leverages AI-powered anomaly detection.
- Monitors commands, file access, network requests, and user inputs for suspicious activity.
- Detects multi-stage attack chains and supports auto-learning for dynamic rule updates.
- Outputs clear threat responses: BLOCK, ALERT, or ALLOW.
- Integrates with OpenClaw logs and supports Linux environments with Node.js and Python.
